gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-padyakke-expande: Loose, hand-drawn charm up top, with Shantell Sans keeping one fixed nib width throughout. And Padyakke Expanded One, a classic serif, spreads its round, wide-mouthed letters out slowly, so a bigger heading over smaller text feels natural.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding, level and a bit blunt: that is Sniglet in a nutshell. BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, has curvy, unclamped letters and thin joins as sturdy as its stems, so a long passage drifts along at a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru brings generous letterspace and terminals that stop well short of the stem. Sniglet sits above it with a quiet, level beat, so the heading stays distinctive while the text serif underneath keeps its traditional, editorial footing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is a dignified serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase forms. And Snowburst One, a stencil with wide bridges between letters, makes that bold-meets-classic mix the strongest thing about the pairing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-glegoo: Expressive is the first word for Snowburst One, a stencil display face with bridges between letters and tall lowercase that grabs attention fast. But Glegoo, a classic serif, does the quieter job, with big counters and curved letters whose mouths stay wide and unclosed.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-hanuman: Snowburst One is a stencil display face, with wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase built for attention. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, then reads in a refined, traditional way over a full page.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-kadwa: Kadwa, a classic serif, reads with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height that feel editorial and settled. Snowburst One handles the loud stencil display; Kadwa handles the reading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noticia-text: A stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters defines Snowburst One, and its tall lowercase adds to the boldness. But Noticia Text, a dignified serif, gives each curved letter a big visible entrance and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-piazzolla: Snowburst One cuts its bold display letters like a stencil, with wide bridges between them and a tall lowercase. Piazzolla, a text serif, keeps lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so paragraphs read with refined authority.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-pridi: The stencil bridges between letters make Snowburst One instantly recognizable, and its lowercase is built tall. Pridi, a text serif, answers with small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, and generous space between curve ends and the stem.
